measures.error: largest relative error of the downhill distance against s = a t (t + h) / 2 over G40's rolling and sliding runs
measures.variance: contact-point slip speed at the end of G40's rolling run (0 when it rolls)
measures.robustness: share of 12 random inclines (5-40 deg, mu_s 0.05-1, mu_d = 0.7 mu_s; 1.5 deg around the critical angle excluded) whose roll/slide regime disagrees with tan(theta) <= 3.5 mu_s, or failing a validator
